The Space:

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8):

- Master Suite I, First Floor: King Bed, Smart TV, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower and stand alone Bathtub

- Master Suite II, First Floor: King Bed, Smart TV, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom, Second Floor: Queen Bed, shared Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom II, Second Floor: Queen Bed, shared Bathroom with Walk-in Shower



Relaxation and adventure await at our 'Sweet Bay' beach home at Inlet Beach, boasting 2,725 square feet and offering accommodations for up to 8 guests in 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms.



'Sweet Bay' is conveniently positioned just north of Highway 98 and behind 30Avenue, a premium shopping center that is home to a host of amazing local restaurants. Hop on the golf cart or one of the beach cruiser bicycles to get to the beach in style! Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be!



Newly constructed with a rejuvenating coastal ambiance, this two-story Florida home offers the peace and tranquility of a perfect coastal getaway. Its prime location is just minutes from the sugar-white beaches, as well as plenty of shopping, entertainment, and dining options, all along County Highway 30A!



Hardwood floors, quartz counter-tops, gourmet kitchen, private pool and beachy undertones are just a few of the features that make this multi-level home a worthwhile escape. The large, open-plan living and dining room offers plenty of space for the whole family. The living room offers comfy furnishings, while the dining area offers seating for up to 6 guests with additional seating for 4 at the breakfast bar.



The first master suite is located on the first floor, sporting a king-sized bed and a private, luxurious bathroom, complete with a vanity and walk-in shower. The second Master Suite bedroom on the first floor features a king-sized bed with a full bathroom. The second floor holds two additional bedrooms: TWO (2) Guest Rooms, each with a queen-sized bed and a shared bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. In addition, the second floor loft provides the perfect space for the kids to hang out.



Outdoor living shines here with a heated pool featuring a sun shelf, a backyard recreation area with artificial turf, and an outdoor kitchen with BBQ, sink, and refrigerator surrounded by lush palms and professional landscape lighting.



Enjoy our 4 Adult Bicycles and golf cart, to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to the beach, Alys Beach, Seacrest, Rosemary Beach and more!!



This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn!

(Excludes Beach towels)



Bring your Beach Toys and Towels to Stay Awhile!!



Beach Access: There are several convenient beach accesses to choose from! All you have to pick is how you want to get there! Use the bikes (already located at the home) to get there quick!



Below are 3 of the most popular accesses:

- Winston Lane Public Beach Access: Located about a mile from the Preserve at Inlet Beach. At the end of Winston Lane, on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary Beach, where the road dead ends at the gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking available.

- Wall Street Beach Access: Located about a mile drive from the Preserve at Inlet Beach, about 200 yards east of the intersection of US 30A and Highway 98, at the end of South Wall Street, where it dead ends at the Gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking.

- Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access on 30A, and features three dune walkovers, as well as plenty of public parking, is only a mile away from the home. It is complete with restrooms, as well as lifeguards on-duty during peak season.



A half-mile walk to the east is Camp Helen State Park and Lake Powell!



Just offshore is one of South Walton's artificial reefs, a focal point for snorkeling and SCUBA with abundant fish, dolphins and sea turtles - Grouper Reef!



Community Pool: TBD

 

Nearby Restaurants and Shopping: 30Avenue plaza with premier shopping, dining and services is 10 minute walk from the home. 

For Dining - La Cocina Mexican Grill and Bar, Acme Ice House, Wild Olives Market and Cafe, Cowgirl Kitchen, George's At Alys Beach, Caliza Restaurant, Crabby Steves, Summer Kitchen Cafe, Barbacoa Mexican Grill, The Donut Hole, Freshii, Roselie Dining, AmaVida Coffee and Tea, Wet Your Whistle Coffee & Smoothie Spot, and much more!



Other Things to Note:

Reasons to Book “SWEET BAY” TODAY:

Attention: Please note our age requirement policy for March/April: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.



Please note, two (2) night reservations are subject to a lower max occupancy. A two night reservation max sleeping capacity is equal to half of the standard max occupancy restriction for the unit.



* Promotions may change, be cancelled and dates may be blacked out at BeachWalk's sole discretion and without notice.

* Rates, availability and minimum stay requirements are subject to change without notice.

* Please check Walton/Okaloosa County local news outlets for up-to-date closures that may affect your vacation.*



NO PETS:

Unfortunately, pets are not permitted in PROPERTY NAME. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of any necessary steam-cleaning or deodorizing. Violations may also result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.





NO SMOKING OR VAPING:

Smoking/Vaping is not permitted in PROPERTY NAME. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of any necessary steam-cleaning or deodorizing. Violations may also result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



GOLF CART:

The Golf Cart is provided to the Guest by a 3rd Party Vendor, BeachWalk Vacation Gear, LLC ("BVG, LLC"). The rental policy signed is between the Guest and BVG, LLC. Golf Cart is not owned or provided to the Guest by the Homeowner or BeachWalk Vacation Properties, LLC.



STARTER AMENITY PACKS: At Beachwalk Vacations, we provide essential items for our guests to use until they can stock up at the store. In the kitchen, you'll find dishwashing soap, two dishwasher pods, and one roll of paper towels. For the bathrooms, we supply two rolls of toilet paper per bathroom, along with basic amenities such as shampoo and a soap bar (similar to hotel-style, but not restocked during your stay). We also provide professionally laundered bed linens and towels with your reservation. For your convenience, we recommend bringing your own beach towels for use at the pool and beach.



Interaction with Guests:

Questions?

Contact us by responding to our Confirmation/Welcome Message.

Confirmation will be emailed and/or texted upon booking.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
